stem.text: Four cuboids with identical lengths, breadths and heights are immersed in water. The cuboids are held at the same depth and in identical orientations by vertical rods, as shown.

stem.alt: Four cuboids hanging by vertical rods below a water surface, labelled W, X, Y and Z, with printed densities 4ρ, 2ρ, ρ and 0.5ρ.

stem.text: Cuboid W is made of material of density $4\rho$.
Cuboid X is made of material of density $2\rho$.
Cuboid Y is made of material of density $\rho$.
Cuboid Z is made of material of density $0.5\rho$.

A.text: The upthrust of the water on each of the cuboids is the same.

B.text: The upthrust of the water on W is twice the upthrust of the water on X.

C.text: The upthrust of the water on X is twice the upthrust of the water on W.

D.text: The upthrust of the water on Y is zero.
